proof: The default render contains one Source controller command and one named owner for every declared loop worker.

Consultation, Deployment, policy-learning, and health-monitor tests exercised durable replay or fresh health-file recovery semantics.
A failing consumer can be disabled while its owning service remains degraded and durable work stays visible.
The change introduces no parallel owner; rollback is the single Compose integration commit with live-capital defaults still false.
